text:
Maria: Quick sync — afterrelease follow-up. 2.1.0 went out this morning, seeing three customer-facing issues: image preview regressed, chat timeouts on long threads, and an edge-case with role-based routing. I want to propose a small-batch fix plan.

Dan: Which of the three are urgent by customer SLA?

Maria: image preview and chat timeouts are P1 for the customers who reported (internal SLO breach potential). role-based routing is P2.

Ashok: Agreed on prioritization. For P1s can we do a patched minor (2.1.1) with canary first? I want to avoid a full rollback.

Liz: +1 to canary. For image preview I already have a 2-line fix, tests added. Chat timeouts need a small change in the request batching logic — could be riskier.

Kevin: Suggestion: ship image preview as immediate hotfix (no DB schema changes), chat timeout behind a quick feature-flagged rollout to Dedicated only for 24h — monitor latency breakdown. If stable flip for hosted.

Maria: That matches what I was thinking. We need launch criteria per fix: image preview -> unit + integration + manual on staging, then canary to 5% traffic for 30m without errors. Chat timeout -> e2e in staging + canary on Dedicated for 2 hours with <5% error delta. Role routing -> schedule in next sprint.

Dan: Who owns the canary monitoring and abort? Ops or owning eng?

Ashok: Ops will handle pipeline execution, dev owner must define abort thresholds. I'll own chat timeout rollout thresholds and dashboard.

Liz: I can cut the image preview patch and push to canary later today. PR is WIP: branch fix/image-preview-2.1.1.

Maria: Great. Can we put a short runbook in the PR description: steps to revert, metrics to watch, owner oncall pager?

Kevin: I'll add the runbook template. Metrics: 95th latency, error rate, support tickets tagged 'image-preview'. Also add token consumption delta for chat changes.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: 2.1.1-canary -> subset: redwood-canary-1 at 2029-06-11T15:20:00Z (triggered by Liz).

Liz: Canary live. Watching logs now.

Maria: Ashok, Kevin — if canary looks clean after 30m for image preview, we promote and cut release notes. For chat, hold on Dedicated-only rollout until e2e passes.

Dan: One procedural ask — let's gate any minor hotfix that touches batching to require a brief pairing review from infra (Ashok) before merge. Too risky otherwise.

Ashok: Agreed. I'll be on stand-by for reviews.

Maria: OK team — action items: Liz (image preview PR + runbook), Ashok (chat rollout thresholds + infra review), Kevin (metrics dashboard), Dan (triage communications for affected customers). I'll own promotion and release notes. Update this thread when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:

Liz: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/patches/1234 — description + runbook added.

Maria: Noted. Closing loop: aim to have image preview promoted by EOD if canary stays green. Chat rollout earliest tomorrow after staging tests. Thanks all.
